remarks: "OPEN HOUSE CANCELED 1/18/26" Welcome to this stunning Westover ranch, set on a sweeping driveway and filled with beautiful natural light. The open floor plan features a vaulted Great Room with fireplace, dining area, and granite kitchen with center island and six-burner dual-fuel range - all under soaring ceilings with skylights and cove lighting, and a wall of sliders overlooking the stone patio and gorgeous landscaped yard. The private primary suite offers a bedroom with fireplace, vaulted ceiling & 2 skyligths; updated full bath and walk-in closet. Two additional bedrooms are tucked off the main-level family room, along with a beautifully updated full bath. An office, powder room, workroom/shed, and direct access to the two-car garage complete the main level. The partially finished lower level provides flexible space with a playroom, office, and den, plus a large storage and mechanical room with washer and dryer. Outside, enjoy a lovely two-level fenced yard with bluestone patio, stone walls adorned with pollinator-friendly perennials and plenty of room for entertaining, play, or quiet relaxation. Located on a quiet cul-de-sac in desirable Westover with hardwood floors on the main level, city water and sewer, just minutes to the Merritt Parkway, schools, houses of worship, and a short drive to vibrant downtown Stamford and Harbor Point. A truly special home.
